verdict.rationale: Docs show broad multi-modal support (text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D) via 'one open runtime' and a model gallery with pull-from-Hugging Face/Ollama, backend flexibility, and aliasing, which corroborates wide model-architecture coverage. However, no explicit documentation confirms support for hundreds of distinct architectures, Mixture-of-Experts models, or embedding-model support specifically. missing for 10: explicit MoE model support evidence, explicit embedding-model support evidence, quantitative claim of architecture count.
